You can export your ChatGPT conversations `using OpenAI's built-in data export tool, browser extensions, or manual methods`.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF18g-h3LcxZcMzxECzM4JFIFIvg-v2IIqTGi25QacSUkXTffK8-N5uUA8lDi_ZaKy9AD01zQaqkH3oyJUHbh05EXtNbfRqQTfnHosZBt26UaMy-vB1NVrelMbj-WscENDFsVsjblTvPLnOFJGspxXH2POxoa0YVjss-H27y_yFmSOdCSi9M7GlcEgsBxvQTl5vBGB3z6k8hSjh1E3DM_8mGH6pXIvH5JGXwFnxCwzaF7QVOzy4GObhnlwd7-08n-Rmd_trLmK7o1uen8qe7oko-Q)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)

### Method 1: Export All Chat History (Official Way)

OpenAI lets you download your entire chat history as a ZIP file containing JSON and HTML files.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1-KhYGr8_DGCT2MUG_Cch6f7g8eI28Nsrc2B_y9XIewATaBvYrDXPOl-B3ZfjGROEYxaFr-PR0YXpKG3-qjOs5fSb6hCi8wIbI521DFL-yu6dOS3qFHcD6vA_5ENTCYWETT4TMv4UkREklBQlwlBbpk012f86izUuTaWSuaEsFaIJv6snJZrTwcqop8)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nque60rkbe8)

1. Log in to [ChatGPT](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHEIkXXDKkefzdYoFwUI8RQ8SLE6SLymrLH-l9Hctd6FhRdTYRl8A3MgN7pcUAxDjhQxrdFTBrNSceHpchengFQXH_GeuTM5z_SCycxr0OS).
2. Click your **profile icon** in the bottom-left corner.
3. Select **Settings** > **Data controls**.
4. Click **Export** or **Export data** , then confirm the request.
5. Complete any verification prompts (such as a code sent via email or SMS).
6. Wait for an email from OpenAI (this can take anywhere from a few minutes up to 7 days).
7. Click **Download data export** in the email. *Note: The link expires after 24 hours.* 
8. Unzip the downloaded file to view your data, which includes a readable `chat.html` file or raw JSON files.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3QbxZr7J4L4)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E08P_Of2Ui8&t=4)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1-KhYGr8_DGCT2MUG_Cch6f7g8eI28Nsrc2B_y9XIewATaBvYrDXPOl-B3ZfjGROEYxaFr-PR0YXpKG3-qjOs5fSb6hCi8wIbI521DFL-yu6dOS3qFHcD6vA_5ENTCYWETT4TMv4UkREklBQlwlBbpk012f86izUuTaWSuaEsFaIJv6snJZrTwcqop8)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nque60rkbe8)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXX_KpvhpXLk4ec5D__Th26rWwxTBTjvFznpEYW7CQIScBCOk34l7zZVPjOBx5Q86kzFTwY5kr5WuzSz5_Dfva8Yk5qMDV8KeV1n-UpQdE56WVrg47qougA2GLbgB2kID0h2i9EIWrLVq4bkGUH)[[7]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/esX4PAb2rbc)

### Method 2: Export a Single Conversation
If you only need to save or share one specific chat thread:

- **Share a read-only link:** Open the conversation, click the **Share** icon at the top right, and choose **Copy link**.
- **Save as PDF via browser:** Open the conversation, press `Ctrl + P` (Windows) or `Command + P` (Mac), and select **Save as PDF** as your destination.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF1xWDSQzQFARd3BnJJyTf2zLG_NZab-PvmQvDWuZPiac7Yg67NWZ2jz1IXrntNevB0U1CXVPoDGsB6GDyOxKG91MF6Eq1TlJFG96VHBUOddG4ZJ_MvSOjgvOH8sIEyvlumXRu2IRbycnY2EJ279gOVcensw1iz5KK5ECrKnj1MOuo-ZSHK9tFhPDKnWQrVpqtVmfjjFLd)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E08P_Of2Ui8&t=4)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rCVXWIthDc&vl=en-US&t=9)

### Method 3: Use Browser Extensions or Scripts
Opinions are mixed on manual methods for large threads, as users on the [OpenAI Community Forum](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF18g-h3LcxZcMzxECzM4JFIFIvg-v2IIqTGi25QacSUkXTffK8-N5uUA8lDi_ZaKy9AD01zQaqkH3oyJUHbh05EXtNbfRqQTfnHosZBt26UaMy-vB1NVrelMbj-WscENDFsVsjblTvPLnOFJGspxXH2POxoa0YVjss-H27y_yFmSOdCSi9M7GlcEgsBxvQTl5vBGB3z6k8hSjh1E3DM_8mGH6pXIvH5JGXwFnxCwzaF7QVOzy4GObhnlwd7-08n-Rmd_trLmK7o1uen8qe7oko-Q) note that lengthy threads can become cumbersome to manage. Many users prefer third-party options for more readable formats like Markdown, Word, Notion, or PDF:[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF18g-h3LcxZcMzxECzM4JFIFIvg-v2IIqTGi25QacSUkXTffK8-N5uUA8lDi_ZaKy9AD01zQaqkH3oyJUHbh05EXtNbfRqQTfnHosZBt26UaMy-vB1NVrelMbj-WscENDFsVsjblTvPLnOFJGspxXH2POxoa0YVjss-H27y_yFmSOdCSi9M7GlcEgsBxvQTl5vBGB3z6k8hSjh1E3DM_8mGH6pXIvH5JGXwFnxCwzaF7QVOzy4GObhnlwd7-08n-Rmd_trLmK7o1uen8qe7oko-Q)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rCVXWIthDc&vl=en-US&t=9)

- **Chrome Extensions:** Tools like [ExportGPT: Export ChatGPT Conversation](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn) let you one-click export active chats into PDF, Markdown, HTML, or Excel.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)
- **Open Source Scripts:** Developers can use command-line tools or console scripts like the [ChatGPT Conversation Exporter](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXW9yivOEXOEw6U5AZC6ewkOoHCQMV1A-5qEm73Jo7mlPzRzG2SlEJparcYa57nXxgeb_EhKSaTrb7dc1ZZT7_VhZyN7WqGOelShGU4IfpT_XXJwLELd-3La6W_OXtndDXV-VMPtWWxOj4JdTClWFnbA2eeAMHTgg) to pull full histories directly into local Markdown and JSON files.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXW9yivOEXOEw6U5AZC6ewkOoHCQMV1A-5qEm73Jo7mlPzRzG2SlEJparcYa57nXxgeb_EhKSaTrb7dc1ZZT7_VhZyN7WqGOelShGU4IfpT_XXJwLELd-3La6W_OXtndDXV-VMPtWWxOj4JdTClWFnbA2eeAMHTgg)
